Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. When off, explosions behave exactly as they do in vanilla and hurt only characters.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Doors_tooltip: Blasts damage doors and knock them off their hinges. \nDoor toughness is the engine's own: a fence gate goes down easily, a locked security door needs a pipe bomb at point-blank range.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Windows_tooltip: Blasts shatter windows. \nGlass gives way well beyond the range at which anything structural breaks, and a broken window still trips the house alarm.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Fences_tooltip: Blasts bend and flatten fences, leaving the same broken sprites and debris as a car crash. \nWeak fences are blown away from the charge; a close hit smashes them outright.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_PlayerBuilt_toolt: Blasts damage carpentry and metalwork raised by players - walls, gates, barricades. \nTurn this off on a server where charges could be used to breach bases.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Furniture_tooltip: Blasts blow apart furniture that could have been dismantled or carried away, leaving its materials as scrap. \nOnly loose furnishings are affected - never floors, and never load-bearing map walls.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Props_tooltip: Blasts damage the roadside clutter cars can already flatten - signs, posts, meters, light fixtures.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_CharWalls_tooltip: A big enough blast burns eligible walls down to their charred versions, which can be climbed through like a window. \nTimber chars, concrete does not. This is one-way, and it also strips the doors, windows and curtains off the tile, so it is off by default.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_ScorchMarks_toolt: Stain nearby walls and floors with soot where the charge went off. \nCosmetic only. Reserved - scorch marks are not drawn yet, so this setting currently does nothing.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_LeaveScrap_toolti: Wrecked furniture and fences drop the planks, nails and metal they were made of. \nTurn this off if you would rather explosives destroyed materials than produced them.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_BlastPower_toolti: Scales all structural damage, as a percentage. \n100 is the calibrated default, where a pipe bomb breaks a locked security door on the tile it lands on. 0 leaves everything standing.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_BlastRadius_toolt: Scales how far the damage carries, as a percentage of the explosive's own range. \nThis stretches the shockwave without making the charge itself any stronger.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Falloff_tooltip: How sharply damage drops off with distance. \nHigher concentrates the destruction on the tiles nearest the charge; lower spreads it evenly across the whole radius. Default 4.0.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_FurnitureToughnes: How much punishment furniture takes for each point of its carrying weight, so a wardrobe always resists far more than a chair. \nHigher means sturdier. Default 6.0.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_CharThreshold_too: How much blast energy a tile must take before its walls char through. \nLower makes charring common, higher confines it to the heart of a large explosion. Default 0.53, which is the energy that breaks a locked security door.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBombs_Debug_tooltip: Print the position, power and computed energy of every explosion to the console. \nFor tuning and bug reports.
